title: Absorption capacity of separable noise: Bell-mixing thresholds on entanglement and teleportation
summary: We study Bell-mixing lines $ρ_λ=λΦ^+ +(1-λ)σ$, where $Φ^+$ is a fixed Bell reference and $σ$ is a separable two-qubit noise state. Along this line there are two operational crossings: the state becomes entangled, and it reaches quantum teleportation advantage over classical strategies. We package these crossings as capacities of the noise state. The entanglement absorption capacity $C_{\rm abs}(σ)$ is the largest amount of Bell reference that $σ$ can absorb while the partial transpose remains positive.
